InteriorAgent is a collection of high-quality 3D USD assets specifically designed for indoor simulation in NVIDIA Isaac Sim environments.
This represents a balcony room with a rectangular floorplan defined by a clockwise polygon in the Isaac Sim world coordinate system (X-Y plane).
The coordinate system is consistent with Isaac Sim’s world frame: X is forward, Y is right, Z is upward.
